validated_objective: Release QIF v0.6.34 Threshold Robustness with reproducible bounded sensitivity and governance.
scope: Add threshold alternatives, replay outcomes, and robustness summaries to calibration-report.
Add deterministic verifier rules, examples, fixtures, docs, roadmap, and release evidence.
constraints: Use identical source evidence and one consequence policy per analysis.
Do not optimize, rank, select, or authorize policy.
expected_outcomes: Users can see exactly which decisions flip under reviewed alternatives.
Brittleness is routed to accountable governance.
